title: How Thin Are Saturn's Rings?
description:
How Long Do Saturn's Rings Have Left?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=55AEQwvs36g

Saturn's main rings span tens of thousands of kilometres across, yet in places they are only about ten metres thick — ten times thinner than a 100-metre playing field. Drop through those ten metres and you are in open space again.

Sources: NASA, Saturn Fact Sheet / Cassini Solstice Mission (main rings ~10 metres thick in places); Iess et al. 2019, Science (Cassini Grand Finale ring mass and structure).

Pictures: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute Cassini imagery (PIA18367, PIA21057, PIA09805, PIA06092, PIA08992, PIA07872, PIA21886) alongside AI-assisted voice and editing. Facts: every number is checked against the sources listed above.
Image credits: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute.
